people.name: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
people.field: Oriental, especially Hebrew and Semitic Scholar, but also Indologist, and Theologian

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.evidence: After gymnasium studied theology and Oriental languages at Göttingen. Ph.D. there 1823.

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.evidence: from 1824 Repetent at Theological Faculty in Göttingen.

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.evidence: From 1827 ao. Professor of Philosophy at Göttingen, from 1831 ord. there

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.evidence: 1835 succeeded Th. Chr. Tychsen in charge of Oriental languages.

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.role: Professor of Oriental Languages and Literature
relations.evidence: From 1838 Professor of Oriental Languages and Literature at Tübingen

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.evidence: in 1841 moved to Theological Faculty as Professor of Old Testament.

relations.subject: EWALD, Georg Heinrich August (von)
relations.evidence: In 1848, after the political turn in Hannover, returned of his own wish to Göttingen. In 1867 he was deprived of his salary

relations.subject: Karl Friedrich Gauss
relations.evidence: the famous mathematician Karl Friedrich Gauss, Ewald’s colleague at Göttingen

relations.subject: Bollensen
relations.evidence: His encouragement led Bollensen at Göttingen as well as Schleicher and Roth at Tübingen, all originally students of theology, to turn their attention to Sanskrit.
